record.question: Maximum numbers of earth-moving equipments available in Mizoram are
record.explanation: Source check: printed page 4 of the 2016 AE (Civil) under Trade & Commerce, Civil Engineering Paper III, renders Q33 exactly as extracted ('Maximum numbers of earth-moving equipments available in Mizoram are' with options excavators / bull dozers / loaders / excavator-cum-loaders); no underlining, italics or missing symbol, and no shared direction or passage applies to it. Reasoning: Mizoram is a steep hill state, so the bulk of earth work is benching and cut-slope excavation for road formation; this is done by tracked excavators with rock breakers, whereas bulldozers are unsuitable for (and environmentally restricted on) fragile hill slopes, loaders are only needed at borrow areas and stockpiles so their numbers stay small, and a combined excavator-cum-loader site machine cannot substitute for the excavator fleet on major hill road cuts. Excavators are therefore the most numerous earth-moving equipment. This is a Mizoram-specific fleet fact not derivable from the printed paper, so it is offered as a reasoned proposal at medium confidence.
